verdicts.misleading_risk: Medium. Two parts of the proposal rest on false or infeasible premises. (a) 'The PAT guide that template-synchronization needs is last' is false: personal_access_token.md opens by saying the sync token is a different one and sends readers to template_synchronization.md, which has its own token steps. The PAT guide is for notebooks that call GitHub. (b) Making install.md's Next link 'Open and use an app' cannot work in the template, because using-apps.md is hand-written only in the site repo (content/guides/using-apps.md). It would be a dead link in the template and on GitHub. (c) Moving installer-images and app-manifest to after the release contradicts the template: installer_images.md says customisation 'can be done when initialising your repository', and initialise_repository.md asks for the images and the summary as inputs to the form, with app_manifest.md saying the form creates the file.
